observations: Photo 0 shows a large flat-screen TV displaying a landscape scene with a red car on a gravel road lined with tall trees. The screen has a visible on-screen menu overlay with 'LG UHD 4K', '65UT73', 'α7 Gen 8', 'webOS', and 'ThinQ' logos.
Photo 1 shows the same TV displaying a close-up of green grapes with leaves. The same on-screen menu is visible, showing 'LG UHD 4K', '65UT73', 'α7 Gen 8', 'HDR10 Pro', 'webOS', and 'ThinQ'.
The TV has a thin black bezel and is mounted or placed on a stand against a wall. A framed picture is visible above the TV in both photos.
The on-screen menu in both photos clearly shows the model number '65UT73'.
The seller claims it is an LG 65" UT7300 WebOS AI ThinQ 4K UHD HDR Smart TV, Gen 8 Alpha 7, HDR10 Pro, Filmmaker Mode, AI... — which aligns with the on-screen display.
The screen appears to be functioning and displaying vibrant colors with good contrast.

claims.claim: LG 65" UT7300 WebOS AI ThinQ 4K UHD HDR Smart TV
claims.evidence: The on-screen menu in photo 0 and photo 1 clearly shows 'LG UHD 4K', '65UT73', 'webOS', and 'ThinQ'.
The on-screen menu in photo 0 and photo 1 shows 'α7 Gen 8'.
The on-screen menu in photo 1 shows 'HDR10 Pro'.
The on-screen menu does not show 'Filmmaker Mode', but it is a known feature of this model. Cannot be confirmed from photos alone.
The on-screen menu shows 'AI ThinQ', which supports the AI claim.

risks.risk: Physical damage or screen defects (e.g., dead pixels, burn-in, cracks)
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the screen showing the entire surface, especially in a dark room with a uniform color test (e.g., black screen or white screen).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially having screen defects, which could reduce value significantly.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged ports or accessories (HDMI, power cable, remote, etc.)
risks.proof: A photo showing the back of the TV with all ports visible, and a photo of the included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly missing accessories, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Non-functional or degraded performance (e.g., slow response, software issues, no internet connectivity)
risks.proof: A video clip showing the TV turning on, navigating the webOS interface, connecting to Wi-Fi, and playing a video stream.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly not working, which is the worst-case scenario.

proof_requests: A close-up photo of the entire screen in a dark room with a black or white test pattern to check for dead pixels or burn-in.
A photo of the back of the TV showing all ports and connections.
A photo of the included accessories (remote, power cable, etc.).
A video clip showing the TV turning on, navigating the webOS interface, and playing a video stream.
response.reason: The model and key features are confirmed from the on-screen display, but critical hidden risks such as screen defects, missing accessories, and functionality cannot be verified from the current photos. These risks significantly affect the price and must be proven before pricing.
